target.title: fix(ai): serialize ChatGPT websocket message decode order
target.body:
Closes #105435

## What Problem This Solves
`parseWebSocket` started an independent async decode task per `message` event. Blob-like frames await `arrayBuffer()` while strings decode immediately, so later frames could enter the parser queue first and reorder Responses stream events.

## Why This Change Was Made
Serialize decode-and-parse on a per-socket promise chain so arrival order is preserved without dropping the accepted binary/Blob path. Codex sibling `responses_websocket.rs` already consumes one WebSocket message at a time before reading the next; OpenClaw now matches that ordering invariant while keeping Blob compatibility.

## User Impact
ChatGPT Responses websocket streams no longer reorder events when a delayed Blob decode races a later text frame. Normal string-only traffic behavior is unchanged aside from the ordered chain.

## Evidence
- Codex contract checked: `../codex/codex-rs/codex-api/src/endpoint/responses_websocket.rs:686-808` (sequential `ws_stream.next()`, binary rejected as unexpected).
- Local: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-chatgpt-responses.test.ts` — 33 passed, including delayed Blob + string completion ordering regression.
- `git diff --check` clean on touched files.
